note: The OLG has extensive coverage of work requirements under SNAP > SNAP Work Rules (General and ABAWD). FNS 850.6 requires that recipients provide ongoing employment status/job availability information, with disqualification for noncompliance without good cause. The OLG covers this through multiple pages: 'The General Work Rules' requires non-exempt clients to register for work at application and recertification; 'General SNAP Work Requirements Policy and Procedures' lists the regulatory framework (106 CMR 362.300-362.340); 'Good Cause Criteria for Not Complying with the General Work Rules' details good cause determinations; 'SNAP Disqualifications and Sanctions' covers disqualification for voluntary quit/noncompliance; and 'The SNAP Work Rules Screening Page' provides detailed BEACON procedures for screening exemptions and tracking compliance. The OLG also covers ABAWD-specific work rules, strikes, disqualification, and regaining processes. Exemptions are documented with screening criteria and BEACON workflows. The FNS section's QC-specific review procedures (reviewer presumptions, variance classification, timeliness of disqualification review) are not in the OLG, but those are QC methodology rather than caseworker policy.
